codegen.barrier_audit: The control retains its eight-stage stride reduction as a loop, so two static s_barrier opcodes execute nine dynamic synchronizations. The selected candidate unrolls the same eight stages, so nine static opcodes execute the same nine dynamic synchronizations. Compact-loop candidates are exact but only about 1.3% faster, so unrolling is retained.

selected_design.description: Cache each existing unrounded BF16+BF16 F32 sum in dynamic LDS during the unchanged local256 RMS accumulation, store the same RNE BF16 residual, then reuse the cached F32 value for the normalized weighted output instead of reloading both BF16 inputs and adding them again.
exact_arithmetic: the first-pass BF16 upcasts, F32 add, square accumulation, per-thread index order, and local256 reduction tree are unchanged
the residual store remains RNE BF16 of the unrounded F32 add
the normalized path consumes that same unrounded F32 add, preserving Laguna control semantics rather than the rounded DFlash residual boundary
inv_rms calculation and left-to-right value*inv_rms*weight operations are unchanged
only the time of the residual store moves earlier inside the same kernel; all outputs become observable at the same kernel-completion boundary
selected_design.fallback: registered add_rmsnorm/gguf_f32_weight/bf16_out for rows, prefill, invalid/unsupported shape, explicit disable, key miss, gfx1151, and every unsupported backend
selected_design.lineage: in-tree DFlash dynamic-LDS staging pattern adapted to preserve Laguna control's unrounded F32 add/RMS boundary; no external kernel port
selected_design.scope: rows=1, hidden_size positive and <=4096, hidden_size divisible by 256, local256, BF16 inputs/outputs, F32 weight, gfx1100 only
